intended_object: An auxiliary tail-recursive helper that sends a walk p from x to y and an accumulator walk q from x to z to the walk "p reversed, then q" from y to z. It is used to implement walk reversal (inferred from the docstring).
explanation: The docstring explicitly calls this an auxiliary tail-recursive operation used to reverse a walk. It is an accumulator-style implementation device, like List.reverseAux, rather than a standard mathematical object. The meaningful object is the reversal of a walk, which this helper serves to define. Mathlib uses the same device for simple graphs (SimpleGraph.Walk.reverseAux). The definition itself is correct: it moves each edge onto the accumulator and flips its direction with h.symm.
